findings.title: Adding the first series does not apply the current range
findings.description: Adding a series only mutates `seriesCountRef`; it neither triggers rendering nor changes this effect’s dependencies. Once an empty chart is ready, adding populated data therefore leaves the current Context range unapplied until `range` changes again. The translation test masks this by calling `setRange` after `addSeries`. Trigger synchronization when data becomes available, and test adding data without changing the range.

findings.title: Series count does not establish that the chart contains data
findings.description: The guard permits range translation after adding `{ type: 'line', data: [] }`, despite the time scale still having no points. Likewise, `updateSeries` can clear the last populated series without decrementing the count. Both paths bypass the empty-chart protection and expose the documented `setVisibleRange` failure. Track actual data availability across additions, updates, and removals; add regression tests for empty series and clearing existing data.
